name: Pirates: Split the Treasure
summary:
One chest of coins, five pirates, and a split that has to survive a vote.

The highest-level pirate proposes how the treasure is divided - generous, greedy, or anything in between. Everyone else has seconds to reject the offer. Say nothing and it passes.

When a split passes, the match ends and the coins are paid out. When enough voters reject, the proposer is out of the match, part of their coins is forfeited into the treasure, and the next pirate proposes a split of a bigger chest among fewer pirates.

Rich one match, broke the next. Live multiplayer, seconds per match, and another five pirates are always gathering around a chest.

A free-to-play, real-time social strategy game.
